name: Orca
description: Live quotes from Orca's SOL / USDC pool, and real swaps on Solana devnet from the agent's own wallet. You see the price and the minimum you get before you confirm.

actions.text: Swap SOL and test USDC on devnet, after you confirm

name: Solana
description: Your agents use their own Solana wallets: check what they hold and send test USDC or SOL to an address you approve. Every transfer waits for your Confirm in chat.

actions.text: Read its wallet address and balances
Send test USDC or SOL on devnet, after you confirm

name: Agora AUSD
description: AUSD is Agora's fiat-backed dollar stablecoin. Your agent holds AUSD in its own Monad wallet, pays people in it, and sends it across borders with the recipient's local amount shown at today's rate. Every payment waits for your Confirm and stays inside your limits. Test AUSD from Agora's faucet.

actions.text: Pay in AUSD, after you confirm
Cross-border sends with the local amount shown
Test AUSD from the Agora faucet

name: Arbitrum
description: Each agent uses its EVM address on Arbitrum Sepolia. Agents read their test ETH and USDC and send to an address you approve. Every send waits for your Confirm. Test funds only.

actions.text: Its Arbitrum Sepolia address and balances
Send test ETH or USDC, after you confirm

name: Aurora Intents
description: Your agent keeps one balance. When a trade or payment needs funds on another chain, it routes them through Aurora Intents (any-chain liquidity, powered by NEAR Intents) in one Confirm card, with refunds back to your balance if it can't fill. Quotes work with an API key; moving real funds is switched on per server.

actions.text: One Confirm card that routes and delivers

name: Base
description: Each agent has its own address on Base. Agents read their Base Sepolia ETH and test USDC and send to an address you approve. Every send waits for your Confirm. Test funds only.

actions.text: Its Base Sepolia address and balances
Send test ETH or USDC, after you confirm

name: Ethereum
description: Each agent has its own Ethereum address. Agents read their Sepolia ETH and test USDC and send to an address you approve. Every send waits for your Confirm. Test funds only.

actions.text: Send test ETH or USDC, after you confirm

name: Hyperliquid
description: Each agent trades from its own Hyperliquid testnet account through an API wallet: a separate key that can place and cancel orders but can never withdraw or move funds. Agents read prices, positions and open orders, and every order waits for your Confirm inside your per-trade and daily limits. Test USDC only.

actions.text: Live prices, positions and open orders
Market and limit orders, after you confirm

name: Mera
description: Mera derives keys from a passkey (WebAuthn PRF), with no seed phrase and nothing secret stored. Your passkey signs you in to Lexari and derives a separate EVM key for each agent, so one Face ID or Touch ID covers all of them. Add it in Settings, Security.

actions.text: A separate key for each agent from one passkey
Same keys on every device your passkey syncs to

name: Monad
description: Each agent uses its EVM address on Monad testnet (chain 10143). Agents read their MON balance and send test MON or USDC to an address you approve. Every send waits for your Confirm. Test funds only.

actions.text: Its Monad testnet address and MON balance
Send test MON or USDC, after you confirm

name: Nansen
description: Your agents look up any wallet on Nansen and read its current holdings in USD before they answer. Read only. Needs a Nansen API key on the server.

actions.text: Smart money flows, checked before every trade

name: Robinhood Chain
description: Each agent uses its EVM address on Robinhood Chain testnet (chain 46630). Agents read their test ETH and send to an address you approve. Every send waits for your Confirm. Test funds only.

actions.text: Its Robinhood Chain testnet address and ETH balance
Send test ETH, after you confirm

name: SKR
description: SKR (mint SKRbvo6Gf7GondiT3BbTfuRDPqLWei4j2Qy2NPGZhW3) is a top up coin. Send it to your own Solana deposit address and it converts at the live price into your USD balance, with a 5% SKR bonus. Plans and agent hires can be paid with SKR from the same Confirm sheet. Your balance always shows in dollars.

actions.text: Top up your balance with SKR on Solana
Pay for plans and hires with SKR, 5% bonus

name: Tempo
description: Each agent gets its own Tempo address. Agents read their pathUSD and AlphaUSD balances, get test stablecoins from the Tempo faucet, send to an address you approve and top up your Lexari balance from their Tempo wallet. Fees are paid in the stablecoin itself. Every send waits for your Confirm.

actions.text: Pay APIs that charge over MPP (HTTP 402) with the agent card, after you confirm
Its Tempo address and stablecoin balances
Send pathUSD or AlphaUSD, after you confirm
Top up your Lexari balance from its Tempo wallet
Pay merchants with its Tempo card, inside card limits, after you confirm

name: Uniswap
description: Your agents get live Uniswap v3 quotes and swap ETH and test USDC from their own wallet on Base Sepolia, Ethereum Sepolia and Arbitrum Sepolia. You see the price and the minimum you get before you confirm. Testnet pool prices are not market prices.

actions.text: Live quotes across pool fee tiers
Swap ETH and test USDC, after you confirm

name: 0G Compute
description: Lexari runs the Kimi, Qwen and GLM models through the 0G Compute router, so agents can answer on decentralized inference. Nothing on chain is signed by agents here.

actions.text: Chat on Kimi, Qwen and GLM through 0G Compute

name: Jupiter
description: Your agents pull live Jupiter quotes from Solana mainnet as a price reference, for memecoins and blue chips alike. Read only: nothing is swapped.

name: LI.FI
description: Your agents get live LI.FI quotes for moving a token from one chain to another (Solana, Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Bitcoin): what you'd receive, the route, fees and time. Read only: nothing is bridged.

name: Polymarket
description: Your agents search Polymarket, read live odds and each outcome's order book price. Polymarket only trades with real USDC on Polygon (there is no test order book), so placing orders stays off until it's switched on for your account. When it is on, every order waits for your Confirm inside your per-trade and daily limits.

actions.text: Live odds and order book prices
Buy an outcome on Polygon mainnet, after you confirm

name: Zcash
description: Each agent has its own transparent Zcash address. Agents quote how much ZEC part of your balance buys, delivered straight to that address. Zcash has no test network for this, so buying uses real funds and stays off until it's switched on for your account. When it is on, every buy waits for your Confirm.

actions.text: Live ZEC quotes from your balance
Buy ZEC from your balance, after you confirm

name: Alchemy
description: Alchemy powers Lexari's Monad connection (RPC) and its Token API: your agent can list every token it or any address holds on Monad, with names and amounts. Read only; it never moves money.

name: Kuru
description: Your agents get Kuru routes on Monad testnet and swap from their own Monad wallet. Every swap waits for your Confirm inside your per-trade and slippage limits. Test tokens only.

actions.text: Live routes and quotes on Monad testnet

name: Panta
description: Your agents browse Panta markets, read live YES / NO prices and get real quotes. On devnet a position you confirm is recorded as a paper position at Panta's real quote (Panta settles in mainnet USDC, so no money moves yet).

actions.text: Browse markets and live YES / NO prices
Paper positions on devnet, after you confirm
Positions marked to live prices, closed with profit and loss

name: Solami
description: Solami's RPC, webhooks and Beam power wallet history, incoming transfers and faster transaction landing. Solami serves Solana mainnet, so it switches on with Lexari mainnet.
